cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You lost the chess game. Wash the dishes as agreed, please; glasses first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we were joking about the washing-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You pointed out the greasy pan when you had my queen. Please apply the same terms now I've checkmated you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we play again for double or nothing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After this load. Dry your hands before touching the pieces; I won't let another wager replace one you haven't settled.
